top5_traits: Top-5 by impressions are all logistics / sourcing FAQ queries (stockx shipping, usps vs ups, pandabuy, dhgate, customs).
All top-5 sit on page 1-2 (pos 6-30) yet CTR is ~0 — demand is in the index but not in the click.
how-long-does-stockx-take-to-ship alone draws 21,925 impr (~43% of all article impressions) — single biggest leverage point.
None of the top-5 are year-dated; the ceiling is SERP presentation (title/meta/snippet), not freshness.
Highest-impression pages skew informational (how-long / is-X-legit) — right intent for GEO/AI-citation harvesting once optimised.
bottom5_traits: Bottom pages are thin posts with <30 impr and 0 clicks — minimal index footprint.
Several bottom pages rank deep (pos >30, up to 64) — Google sees them as low-relevance for their target query.
A cluster of duplicate in-page TOC anchor URLs (#elementor-toc__heading-anchor-N) pollute the index with no standalone value.
Year-dated slugs (best-dhgate-sellers-in-2024) bleed authority across anchor variants and look stale.
Bottom group has no click/inquiry signal at all — safe to kill/merge without traffic risk.
